findings.current: The closer one gets to one's destination, the more difficult things become. It was human instinct.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit several-fold increase expressed by 몇 배로 and turns the single causal observation into an unnatural fragment.
findings.rationale: 몇 배로 means several times or many times harder, not merely more difficult.
findings.replacement: It was human nature for things to feel several times harder the closer one got to one's destination.
findings.source: 목적지가 가까워질수록 몇 배로 힘들어지는 것은 인간의 본능이고,

findings.current: The river poured out along with the water plants clinging to my bloated body.
findings.defect: The draft makes the river itself pour out of him; the source describes river water and the plants cascading off his swollen body.
findings.rationale: 강물과 함께 modifies the plants falling away with the river water; it does not mean the river itself pours out.
findings.replacement: River water and the plants clinging to my bloated body came pouring off me.
findings.source: 퉁퉁 불어 있던 몸뚱어리에 달라붙어 있던 수초(水草)가 강물과 함께 쏟아져 내린다.

findings.current: Exhausted, I blinked. The crowd gathered like a bank of clouds at the distant ferry landing, along with several familiar faces, was rapidly drawing closer.
findings.defect: The sentence has broken subject-verb agreement and awkwardly treats the familiar faces as something separate from the crowd.
findings.rationale: The source presents a distant crowd containing several recognizable faces as Taekyung approaches the landing.
findings.replacement: Exhausted, I blinked. The crowd gathered like a bank of clouds at the distant ferry landing was rapidly drawing closer, and I could make out several familiar faces among them.
findings.source: 나는 기진맥진한 채 눈을 깜빡였다. 저 멀리 나루터에 구름처럼 모여든 군중과, 몇몇 익숙한 얼굴들이 빠르게 가까워지고 있었다.

findings.current: Jin Wikyung, who was practically in tears.
findings.defect: The draft substantially softens Jin Wikyung's reaction from nearly wailing or sobbing aloud to merely having tears in his eyes.
findings.rationale: 통곡 denotes loud, unrestrained weeping, making this a stronger emotional and comic beat than being in tears.
findings.replacement: Jin Wikyung, who was practically bawling his eyes out.

findings.current: It wasn't a flame. It was closer to someone's pupil.
findings.defect: The anatomical singular “pupil” gives the wrong image; the source compares the red light to someone's eye or eyes.
findings.rationale: 눈동자 here evokes an watching eye, reinforced immediately by 안광 staring at him, rather than a disembodied pupil.
findings.replacement: It wasn't a flame. It looked more like the glow of someone's eyes.
findings.source: 불꽃이 아니다. 그것은 차라리 누군가의 눈동자에 가까웠다.

findings.current: “It has been about forty years… No, wait. Could you please listen to me, Benefactor?”
findings.defect: The draft drops 족히, which stresses that it has been a full forty years or more and sharpens Jung Ho's bewildered correction.
findings.rationale: 족히 expresses a minimum or ample amount, not a neutral approximation.
findings.replacement: “A good forty years, at least… No, wait. Could you please listen to me, Benefactor?”
findings.source: 족히 사십 년 정도…… 아니, 잠깐 제 말을 들어 주시겠습니까. 시주.

findings.current: “…I am the Master of the Discipline Hall at Shaolin.”
findings.defect: The established office title is not used.
findings.rationale: 계율원주 is bindingly established as “Discipline Hall Master.”

findings.current: He clearly wanted to give me a piece of his mind, but was holding back because I had received his help.
findings.defect: The beneficiary of the prior help is reversed. Jung Ho is restraining himself because he has received help, not because Taekyung received help from him.
findings.rationale: The omitted subject of 받은 is Jung Ho, whose expression and restraint are being described throughout the sentence.
findings.replacement: He clearly wanted to give me a piece of his mind, but was holding back because he owed me for the help he'd received.
findings.source: 마음 같아선 한소리 하고 싶은데, 그래도 받은 도움이 있어서 참는다는 기색이 역력했다.

findings.current: *But why was the Master of Shaolin's Discipline Hall beside me the moment I opened my eyes?*
findings.defect: The narration again fails to use the established office title.
findings.rationale: 계율원주 is bindingly established as “Discipline Hall Master.”
findings.replacement: *But why was Shaolin's Discipline Hall Master beside me the moment I opened my eyes?*
findings.source: ‘그런데 왜 눈 뜨자마자 소림사 계율원주가 옆에 있지.’

findings.current: “I told you to brush your teeth before bed. You damn beggar, your mouth is practically a swamp. A fucking swamp.”
findings.defect: The draft adds a second strong profanity absent from the repeated punch line, intensifying the register and weakening the source's blunt repetition.
findings.rationale: The profanity belongs to 거지 새끼 and Taekyung's overall delivery; the final 늪이야, 늪 is emphatic repetition rather than a separate explicit 좆/씨발-level curse.
findings.replacement: “I told you to brush your teeth before bed. You damn beggar, your mouth is a swamp. A goddamn swamp.”
findings.source: “내가 이 닦고 자랬지. 이 거지 새끼는 아가리가 아주 그냥 늪이야, 늪.”

findings.current: Because of these idiots, I had even dreamed—a kind of dream I usually didn't have. And it had been an unpleasant nightmare at that.
findings.defect: The draft changes the point from Taekyung rarely dreaming at all to this being an unusual kind of dream.
findings.rationale: 평소에는 잘 꾸지도 않는 modifies 꿈 generally: he normally seldom dreams.
findings.replacement: Because of these idiots, I'd even had a dream when I hardly ever dreamed at all—and an incredibly unsettling nightmare at that.
findings.source: 이놈들 때문에 평소에는 잘 꾸지도 않는 꿈까지 꿨다. 그것도 찝찝하기 짝이 없는 악몽을.

findings.current: No wonder I had wondered why I could sense two presences.
findings.defect: The doubled “wonder” is unnatural and blurs the source's realization that the visitor explains the second presence.
findings.rationale: 어쩐지 marks a present realization—“so that was why”—followed by his earlier question about the two presences.
findings.replacement: That explained it. I'd been wondering why I could sense two presences.
findings.source: 어쩐지. 느껴지는 기척이 왜 두 개인가 했다.

findings.current: A rough voice emerged from between the lips of a striking monk I had never seen before.
findings.defect: “Striking” can mean attractive or merely notable and fails to convey 인상파, which describes the scarred monk as fierce or intimidating-looking.
findings.rationale: In context, 인상파 refers to his formidable, intimidating appearance, not aesthetic attractiveness.
findings.replacement: A rough voice came from the lips of the fierce-looking monk I had never seen before.
findings.source: 난생처음 보는 인상파 승려의 입술 사이로 거친 목소리가 흘러나왔다.

findings.current: “Fortunately. Though the heavens have grown dim, the Morning Star that rose in the north seems to have grown even brighter.”
findings.defect: “Fortunately” is an unnatural sentence fragment and does not function as Unnamed's expression of relief or gladness.
findings.rationale: 다행입니다 is a personal expression of relief—“I am glad” or “What a relief”—while the following sentence contrasts the dim heavens with the brighter Morning Star.
findings.replacement: “I am glad. Though the heavens have grown dim, the Morning Star that rose in the north seems to shine even brighter.”
findings.source: “다행입니다. 비록 하늘을 흐려졌으나, 북쪽에서 떠오른 신성(新聲)은 더욱 밝아진 듯하군요.”

summary: Two meaningful subject/register defects, several localized fidelity issues, and terminology/natural-English corrections.
